name: Edivoxetine
summary: Edivoxetine (INN; code name LY-2216684) is a drug which acts as a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor and was under development by Eli Lilly for attention-deficit disorder (ADD) and as an antidepressant treatment. It was in phase III clinical trials in 2012 for major depressive disorder, but failed to get approval.

sideEffects.text: Side effects significantly associated with edivoxetine are headache, nausea, constipation, dry mouth and insomnia. The above-mentioned studies report increases of the cardiac rhythm, and one also increases of diastolic and systolic blood pressures.
